title: Exceptions: user exceptions, raise, exception handlers and the On Exception (global handler) action of a UI flow

capabilities.title: UserException, RaiseException, ExceptionHandler (IOnExceptionAction)
capabilities.summary: User exception at @espace (IUserException:<Name>); raise = compact raise step or raw IRaiseExceptionNode (terminal, no outgoing link); handler = IExceptionHandlerNode (Exception, AbortTransaction, LogError), proven in a UI flow On Exception action. Consumers follow a rename by key.

route.operation: create IUserException at @espace; logic step {"raise":"<Exception>","message":"\"...\""} or raw create IRaiseExceptionNode + set Exception/ExceptionMessage; create IOnExceptionAction under a UI flow, IExceptionHandlerNode under it + set Exception/AbortTransaction/LogError; rename/replace/usages/delete on IUserException:<Name>

capabilities.guidance: Retire an exception in this order: set Exception on each handler, replace the raisers, check usages = 0, then delete without force. Literal messages (ExceptionMessage, message nodes) never follow a rename or replace. The compact `handlers` key is accepted by the compiler but no suite job runs it on either lane: raw verbs are the proven path (ODC).

limits.text: Do not repoint IESpace.GlobalExceptionHandler on an app that already has one: it adds three warnings (the flow that lost the role and each flow left uncovered).

An On Exception action has no Start: its nodes were positioned with move x/y because layout required a Start; the kernel now falls back to a handler node (FlowLayout.cs:41) but no job runs layout there.

No suite job creates or edits a handler inside a server/client action with front-A verbs: handlers are proven only in a UI flow On Exception action. A client action that already has a handler is only dumped and laid out (untyped read, not a proof); the compact handlers key is unproven.
limits.origin: matrix a-matrix.json (IExceptionHandlerNode: switch-exception-handler, exception-lifecycle); job:action-edit-lifecycle ops 9, 70-71; kernel/src/Anvil.Core/Kernel/LogicExpander.cs:285

limits.text: A user exception has no writable Description (Name and audit fields only).
Rename and replace never rewrite literals: ExceptionMessage and message texts keep the old name.
Only creating user exceptions and raise nodes (with Exception/ExceptionMessage) is proven; usages, rename, replace and delete of an exception have no O11 job.

No O11 job creates or edits an exception handler with front-A verbs: the compact handlers key (name, exception, abortTransaction, logError, steps) in a server/service action is proven by a unit contract only (Verify, reload, merge); a generated screen data action gets one from html state:true, untyped and static, not a proof.
The A-runtime (11.55.87) lists Name and audit fields only as writable on IUserException (no Description); no O11 job sets one.
The On Exception action of a UI flow has no O11 job.
